This gym has had a huge impact on my life. I started with PT sessions with the awesome Maddie. This gave me the confidence to try some of the crossfit classes. The team of coaches are so good at supporting you, modifying movements as you need and welcoming you.

The other gym users are also really welcoming. It is very cool to work out with people from different backgrounds, ages, levels of fitness. Always inspiring people to watch and learn from. Classes are fun, challenging, progressive and varied. Highly recommended.

I had the pleasure of training at CrossFit Pulmo for 2 weeks whilst staying at their guesthouse (Golden Teak Home). It's such a great gym! The equipment and layout of the box is excellent. Maurice & Shelby have done an incredible job and putting this community together - I felt at home immediately. Special shoutout to Maddie and all the coaches at Pulmo - you're all incredible ❤️

Excellent new gym! Head Coach Maurice has an incredible wealth of weightlifting experience and coach Shelby brings her extensive background in competitive crossfit. I've been working with Maurice since October 2022 and have seen huge improvements in my technique.
We're now focusing on competition prep with the Satuday "Competitor Class" integrating all aspects of crossfit (gymnastics, strongman, cardio endurance) as well as continuing to cycle those weights.
Maurice is also programming for me during the week with workouts tailored to target weaknesses and further build on strengths. 💪
Joining this gym means that you are also joining a welcoming community who will push you towards your goals 🙏

Amazing place amazing community!! Love the vibe and how passionate everyone is. I just get to know CrossFit months ago and I’m so grateful that I found Pulmo! Hope to see myself as a to CrossFitter someday lol😂 …

I dropped in at Pulmo while visiting Chiang Mai, and I was really impressed! The gym is clean, well-equipped, and has a great atmosphere from the moment you walk in. The coach (Maddie) was friendly and knowledgeable, making sure to walk me through the workout and facilities. I felt right at home despite being a drop-in. Everyone was super welcoming, and the class was challenging but fun. If you're in the area and looking for a great place to drop in for a WOD, this is definitely the spot!

Impressive gym, spacious and pet friendly with great equipments and well equipped with weightlifting platform! You can see the amount of love and dedication Maurice and Shelby have put into every small detail. I’ve started weighting program with Maurice and he has been a great help as a coach. My techniques have improved so much in the past few weeks! I’m happy with the progress I’ve made so far and his coaching. I’m very grateful to have found this gym in chaingmai. Also the gym is located near a convenient store and coffee shops with plenty of delicious, healthy meal around! Very great location. I love this gym! 🥰

The facilities are clean, and the coach explains the movements and sequences very well. I was worried since it was my first time, but I think it was a great decision to try it. I plan to exercise consistently in the mornings. Thank you!

Stumbled upon this gem on our visit to Chiang Mai and loved it! Joined the HYROX class which was amazing. Great support throughout the class from the coaches. Make sure to book to avoid disappointment as these classes are popular. Will be back!

This is hands down the best gym I’ve ever been to. I’ve never been someone who feels naturally motivated to work out, but that has completely changed since joining Pulmo. The coaches are kind, knowledgeable, and invested in helping everyone improve. More than anything, they’ve built a community that is incredibly welcoming and supportive. I can’t recommend this gym highly enough.

Did some weight  lifting and WOD here.  Great space nice facility and super friendly staffs
I did drop in here definitely come back again

Never in a million years would I have thought that I would join a CrossFit gym. I always felt super intimidated by CrossFit and group classes. In May I kept seeing ads for Pulmo and decided to try it out. Wow! I am so glad I did! I’ve now been going 3-4 times a week since May and have been blown away by my progress and how much I love it! Maurice and Shelby have created something so beautiful, a welcoming,  encouraging and exciting place that is challenging while also accessible. No matter your fitness level or experience, Pulmo is the place to be! I’ve never experienced so much encouragement while also feeling so challenged to grow and work hard. Whether you’re doing weightlifting, open gym, private coaching or the strength and conditioning classes, you will love this gym! Maurice is such a phenomenal coach and his background as a physiotherapist is such an asset! I know he will help me push myself while also keeping me from sports injuries! Cannot recommend Pulmo enough!

The best CrossFit I have ever been to.
They care about your well-being and teach you good techniques. Great community. They are my family now 💕 …

Great for me. Plenty of class times each day, and a range of different classes during the week.
Instructors and attentive, encouraging and explain each activity well. …

Such a great place with an amazing community!
From day one, I felt truly welcomed—no judgment at all. All fitness levels are embraced here. I hadn’t worked out in a very long time and was feeling pretty weak, but I was never made to feel awkward or out of place. The environment is super supportive, and you’re encouraged to go at your own pace. I’m really glad I found this place!

I’m so not a “CrossFit girly”- but this is a great gym for anyone looking for a solid workout where you feel it everywhere. The coaches are wonderful. It’s really hard for me to motivate myself especially with coaches who say you’re not doing enough, which is not how it is here at all!! Super thankful for this crew for pushing me to do more but in the best way possible. My husband loves the workouts too!!!! If you’re looking for a group class fitness, I highly recommend

I tried the Olympic weightlifting class, and the instructors are very motivating and good at what they do. Very chilled vibes, yet professional and you get a good work out. It’s seems that there are lots of regulars and there is a sense of community and good energy. Looking forward to try the CrossFit class even though I am not a CrossFit person at all! Challenge accepted!

Awesome gym with Hyrox training and CrossFit classes. Came here after training at F45 for a few years. Great international community from every corner of the globe. A top-notch weightlifting community + gym classes 💪 …

Pulmo has created such a welcoming community. The coaches are knowledgeable and attentive. I was intimidated to join a CrossFit gym since my fitness levels were very low but they tailor moves to your ability and push you to grow. Best gym ever!

A must when you are in Chiang mai. This CrossFit box makes you feel like you're coming home. All the members I met were very nice and helpful, so you quickly feel integrated into the community. The trainers work very professionally, with a lot of passion and know-how. I enjoyed my stay here and will definitely be back as soon as possible. Thanks Shelby & Maurice for having me.

This place is an absolute gem. Maurice, Shelby, Kristin, and the rest if the team that keeps this place running are extremely dedicated to building a venue ad community that welcomes everyone. No matter your level of fitness, your short- or long-terms goals, Pulmo will support you. It almost goes without saying that a place run by such supportive and welcoming people also attracts a wonderful group of kind and compassionate gym-goers. Definitely a place where you can plug in, get fit, and enjoy spending time with other like-minded people. Crossfit, Olympic weightlifting, gymnastics, strength training, etc. Get at it!

I joined Pulmo Weightlifting gym in August. I was really nervous, as I had never participated in a team sport, and CrossFit seemed super intimidating to me. However, Shelby instantly made me feel at ease, and the Pulmo community has been so …
Great gym and awesome professional coaches! Very friendly environment and camaraderie.

I've just started my CrossFit journey, and everything is so friendly and supportive! Absolutely love it! The classes are beginners friendly and instructors make sure you won't die, just gently suffer 😅 …

I've been with Pulmo for over a year and honestly it has changed my life. From the coaches to the community, and convenient  and flexible class schedule app. Pulmo crushes it.  Inclusive of ALL people, no matter their skill level. This was very important  to me, as a CrossFit newbie and Mom of two young kids. Fun, informative, professional and kind. Thank you Pulmo crew!!!
Best crossfit gym in Chiang Mai! The owners, Maurice and Shelby, are amazing coaches, and have created a positive community to promote strength and wellness. So glad I joined this gym!
Great CrossFit gym - friendly coaches, nice environment, good location, quality equipment, and great vibes 💪🏋️‍♀️🤸 …

Great atmosphere and spot. Very welcoming  and amazing knowledge! Recommend to those passing by and wanting to get in a great session and those wanting to improve their fitness skills. Thanks for having me team

I was there for a class and it was a blast.
Maurice and shelby are verj experienced coaches Training at a high Level. They are super motivating. Maurice writes down a Training plan for every athlete individually what makes it easy to compete. This is probably the best crossfit gym due to Coaching Skills in Thailand.

This is by far the best physiotherapist I've ever been to. Maurice has great knowledge and a science-based approach to healing injuries.

Unlike most physiotherapy clinics in Thailand, he will not try to push sell you package deals. Instead, he will provide an exercise/rehab plan do do on your own after a thorough two-hour consultation, with follow ups only if needed.

Following his rehab plans, I've had incredible progress recovering from long-term chronic sports injuries as well as acute injuries after accidents.
Amazing place, workout and staff! They made me feel so at ease for a newcomer and new to CrossFit. Highly recommend :)

I’m 44 and knew nothing at all about CrossFit. I came because a friend invited me and I had so much fun. So I’ve stayed :-) Not only are the coaches wonderful but the regulars are encouraging and helpful.
My progress in weightlifting has been improving so much with Maurice, the coach and the owner. Also, my knee injury has been a lot better with his physio therapy. Highly recommend!!!
I was coached by Maurice and I will highly recommend him to anyone. Very pro and results oriented. This place is already a great gym for sure. A lot of knowledge and passion! 🔥 …
Awesome gym, great coaching with personal programming aligned to my personal goals. The physio therapy cured back and shoulder pain that limited all training for weeks.
